title: Self Intro &  Project Explanation
outcome: You will possess the skills to create compelling self-introductions and articulate your projects effectively during interviews. You will also be well-prepared to address typical HR-related interview questions with confidence and clarity, enhancing your overall interview performance.
why: This course aims to equip you with the ability to make a strong impression through impactful self-introductions and project explanations in interviews. Additionally, you will gain proficiency in handling HR-related interview questions with confidence. By providing comprehensive guidance in these areas, the course aims to enhance your communication skills, boost your interview presence, and ensure your readiness to excel in interview scenarios.

resources.title: Course Introduction
resources.content:
## Self Intro &  Project Explanation

Welcome to our engaging course, tailored to help you shine in interviews by mastering the art of effective communication. 

It is designed to equip you with the tools you need to excel in interviews through strong communication. We've divided it into two key sections, each focused on essential interview communication techniques.

**Crafting an Impactful Self-Introduction:**

- Discover the formula of introducing yourself with confidence in interviews. 
- Here you'll learn how to make yourself stand out and leave a positive mark from the very beginning.

**Effective Project Explanation:**

- Learn how to talk about your projects in interviews in a way that captivates interviewers. 
- Think of this as your chance to showcase your work like a professional storyteller. We'll guide you through the process of explaining your projects clearly and impressively.

**Navigating HR-Related Interview Questions:**

But that's not all – we're also here to help you tackle those questions that ask about you and your experiences. Think of it as having a secret weapon to answer confidently and make the best impression possible.

**Applying Communication Skills in Mock Scenarios**

Imagine practicing these communication techniques in mock interview scenarios that mimic real interviews. It's like having a practice ground where you can refine your skills before the actual interview. With each practice, you'll gain more confidence and finesse in your communication.


<MultiLineNote>
- This course isn't just about learning; it's about mastering the art of communication in interviews. We're focused on practical skills that make a real difference in your performance.
- By the end of this course, you'll have the skills and confidence to leave a lasting impression
</MultiLineNote>

resources.title: Demysitifying Self Introduction
resources.content:
# Self Introduction

This reading material will help you prepare to explain your Self Introduction effectively in an interview

#### Unlocking You: The Power of Self Introduction

Self Introduction typically encompasses three main categories. It's important to structure your answer according to the following sections.

## 1. Bio

Bio section involves sharing basic personal information such as name, location, and educational background.

**Example**

My name is Ravi Kumar. I am from Hyderabad, Telangana. I have done B. Tech in Computer science from Apple college, Delhi in 2021.

*Here are some sample sentences you can use to build your Bio* 1. **Name** - My name is Ravi Kumar. - I am Ravi Kumar. 2. **Location** - I am from Hyderabad, Telangana. - My native place is Hyderabad, Telangana. 3. **Education** - I have completed B. Tech in Computer science from Apple college, Delhi in 2021. - I have done B. Tech in Computer science from Apple college, Delhi in 2021. ### 2. My Journey

My Journey describes your past experiences and the path that led you to your current position or situation.

**Example**

After graduating, I took a year to prepare for competitive exams. However, after seeing the opportunities in the IT field, I decided to shift my career. I began exploring courses where I could learn the necessary skills. I came across a program at NxtWave and joined, where I have been learning the necessary technologies continuously and upskilling myself to succeed in this field.

*Find customised sentences below which you can use to build your answer.* 1. **Experience before NxtWave**
Sample Experience-1 - After graduating, **I took a year to prepare for competitive exams. However, after seeing the opportunities in the IT field, I decided to shift my career.** I began exploring courses where I could learn the necessary skills.
Sample Experience-2 - After graduating, **I wanted to get into the IT field because of the numerous opportunities available. To acquire and improve coding and other necessary technical skills,** I began exploring courses where I could learn the required skills.
Sample Experience-3 - After graduating, **I worked as an On-site Engineer for 2 years. However, after seeing the opportunities and growth in the IT field, I decided to shift my career. I want to up skill myself and move up the ladder in IT field.** So, I started exploring courses where I could learn the required skills.
2. **Learning with NxtWave** - I came across a program at NxtWave and joined, where I have been learning the necessary technologies continuously and upskilling myself to succeed in this field. ### 3. Skills and Experience

This section highlights your acquired skills and experiences, showcasing your expertise in building projects. Lastly, express your aspirations to build a solid career in the IT industry.

**Example**

I have learnt HTML, CSS, Python and SQL. I've developed a to-do list app using JavaScript and a Spotify clone app using ReactJS. I'm eager to build a strong career in the IT industry and continue to learn and grow.

*Build your own answer by using the sample templates given below* 1. **Technologies learnt** - I am good in HTML, CSS, Python and SQL. - I have learnt HTML, CSS, Python and SQL. 2. **Project details** - I've developed a to-do list app using JavaScript and a Spotify clone app using ReactJS. 3. **Aspirations** - I'm eager to build a strong career in the IT industry and continue to learn and grow. Let's practice more about Self Introduction in the upcoming sections. - Self Introduction: practice - Self Introduction: AI Mock Interview

resources.title: Demystifying Project Explanation
resources.content:
# Demystifying Project Explanation This guide is designed to train you for answering the question "**Explain your project**". Here you will find a set of common sections categorized by broad themes, the skills in focus within each section, key concepts or words related to that section, and potential explanations for these sections. By the end of this guide, you should be able to explain the **Nxt Trendz** project as below:
I have developed the frontend part of the **Nxt Trendz** online shopping application, which is similar to Amazon. I developed it using **React** in a week. My primary focus was on building the frontend part of the application. This application allows users to log in, search, sort, filter, select products, and add them to the shopping cart. The **learning objective** of this project was to apply concepts such as **authentication**, **state management**, **context**, **page navigation**, **media queries** and **flexbox** in the code by following the clean code guidelines. I implemented a **basic authentication flow** and handled common errors such as **invalid username** and **invalid password**. I used **cookies** to persist user credentials across page reloads. I used **Context** for **state management** for creating a **global state** to manage cart state across routes. I used **React Router** for **navigation** within the application. Additionally, I implemented **protected routes** to control access based on user roles. Since my major focus was building the frontend part of the application, I integrated **mock APIs** for displaying data. I followed **clean code guidelines** by maintaining a consistent folder structure and used meaningful naming conventions, such as prefixing event handlers with *on* and creating **reusable components** throughout the application. To ensure a responsive design, I used media queries and flexbox for layouting. I have planned to develop a backend using **Node.js** and **Express.js** to replace the mock API implementation. This will also allow me to have more control over the data and offer more features like user profiles and product recommendations.

The above project explanation is divided into smaller sections. For each of these sections, a few Skills in Focus and Keywords are provided. By covering all of these, you will arrive at the project explanation given above. The examples provided below are related just to **NxtTrendz** and should be adjusted according to your specific project.
## 1. Introduction to the project - **Keywords:** React, E-commerce Functionality, Learning Objective *Explanation:* "I have developed the frontend part of the **Nxt Trendz** online shopping application, which is similar to Amazon. I developed it using **React** in a week. My primary focus was on building the frontend part of the application. This application allows users to log in, search, sort, filter, select products, and add them to the shopping cart. The **learning objective** of this project was to apply concepts such as **authentication**, **state management**, **context**, **page navigation**, **media queries** and **flexbox** concepts in the code by following the clean code guidelines." --- ## 2. Technical Aspects ### 2.1 Authentication: - **Skills in Focus:** Understanding of Frontend Development - **Keywords:** Authentication, Validation, Cookies *Explanation:* "I implemented a **basic authentication flow** and handled common errors such as **invalid username** and **invalid password**. I used **cookies** to persist user credentials across page reloads."
### 2.2 State Management and Navigation: - **Skills in Focus:** Understanding of Frontend Development, Demonstrate a good understanding of React concepts - **Keywords:** State management, Navigation, Protected Route *Explanation:* "I used **Context** for **state management** for creating a **global state** to manage cart state across routes. I used **React Router** for **navigation** within the application. Additionally, I implemented **protected routes** to control access based on user roles."
### 2.3 API Integration: - **Keywords:** API Integration *Explanation:* "Since my major focus was building the frontend part of the application, I integrated **mock APIs** for displaying data."
### 2.4 Clean Code Guidelines: - **Skills in Focus:** Demonstrate good coding practices - **Keywords:** Clean code guidelines *Explanation:* "I followed **clean code guidelines** by maintaining a consistent folder structure and used meaningful naming conventions, such as prefixing event handlers with *on* and creating **reusable components** throughout the application."
### 2.5 Responsiveness: - **Skills in Focus:** Understanding of Frontend Development - **Keywords:** Responsiveness, Flexbox *Explanation:* "To ensure a responsive design, I used media queries and flexbox for layouting." The sub-sections in **Technical Aspects** may vary based on the project. --- ### 3. Future Improvements - **Skills in Focus:** Demonstrate forward thinking and planning - **Keywords:** Backend *Explanation:* "I have planned to develop a backend using **Node.js** and **Express.js** to replace the mock API implementation. This will also allow me to have more control over the data and offer more features like user profiles and product recommendations."
Remember, confidence and clarity are key during your presentation. Practice explaining your project several times before the interview to ensure you can present effectively. --- **Interview Preparation:** To help you apply the knowledge gained from this guide, you will be having AI mock interviews based on the projects that you have built.

resources.title: Revise Git Commands
resources.content:
# Creating GitHub Account and Git Commands
## Concepts Pushing your code to GitHub Repository Cloning the GitHub repository in CCBP IDE
In this unit, we will revisit Git and few Git commands that will help you to **Push** your code to GitHub and **Clone** your code from GitHub to your CCBP IDE. ## Pushing your code to GitHub Repository **Step 1: Create Github Account and add Repository in GitHub** * Create **Github** account by visiting github.com ![](https://res.cloudinary.com/learning-platform/image/fetch/dpr_auto,w_auto,f_auto,q_auto/https://media-content.ccbp.in/prod/media/profile_pic/card-notes-attachment/5b0f9006-99ff-49ce-92a9-a3a264a6a1d5.png) - Create a new Github _repository_ using **+** button at top right corner of website. ![](https://res.cloudinary.com/learning-platform/image/fetch/dpr_auto,w_auto,f_auto,q_auto/https://media-content.ccbp.in/prod/media/profile_pic/card-notes-attachment/13b56092-3c02-460f-bede-58d8e681a6d2.png) - After clicking on _New repository_ button you can see a screen similar to below. ![](https://res.cloudinary.com/learning-platform/image/fetch/dpr_auto,w_auto,f_auto,q_auto/https://media-content.ccbp.in/prod/media/profile_pic/card-notes-attachment/26ebb966-b769-407d-9915-9350cc08a49f.png) - After creating the GitHub repository you can be able to see a screen similar to below. ![](https://res.cloudinary.com/learning-platform/image/fetch/dpr_auto,w_auto,f_auto,q_auto/https://media-content.ccbp.in/prod/media/profile_pic/card-notes-attachment/a8676616-1be0-4b93-9c93-f6f49059e737.png) - Run this command in the CCBP-IDE terminal to configure your email ID ```text git config --global user.email "Enter your email ID here" ``` #### Example: ```text git config --global user.email "rahul@gamail.com" ``` - Run this command in the CCBP-IDE terminal to configure your name ```text git config --global user.name "Enter your name here" ``` #### Example: ```text git config --global user.name "rahul" ``` **Step 2: Connecting CCBP IDE to your GitHub repository** - Run this command in the CCBP-IDE terminal to create a new local repository ```text git init ``` - Run this command in the CCBP-IDE terminal to create a connection between your local repository and remote repository. You can find this repository-url on the new page when you click on Create a new repository button. ```text git remote add origin ``` #### Example: ```text git remote add origin https://github.com/phanimurari/Import-and-Export-an-Array.git ``` **Step 3: Pushing the code from CCBP IDE to your GitHub repository** - Run this command to add the code changes in the files to the stage area. ```text git add -A ``` - Run this command to save changes to a local repository after staging the changes ```text git commit -m "commit message" ``` #### Example: ```text git commit -m "solution" ``` - Run this command in the CCBP-IDE terminal ```text git branch -M main ``` - Run this command to push your local repository changes to the remote repository ```text git push -u origin main ``` - Enter your GitHub Account **username** and **personal access token** to push your code to GitHub Repository. **Instead of using a password** while authenticating your GitHub account, you must give your **personal access token**. Refer to the link to know how to generate a personal access token. While pasting the personal access token in the terminal, the personal access token won't be visible in the terminal, so after pasting the personal access token, you can press the Enter key.
## Cloning the GitHub repository in CCBP IDE** - Run the below command to clone your GitHub code in coding practice in your CCBP IDE. ```text git clone {git repository URL} ``` In the above command, replace this `{git repository URL}` with your actual Git URL
